blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) judges have become a common way to create large-scale relevance judgments for retrieval evaluation. However, each judgment requires a potentially expensive call to a frontier model, and the judgments are hard to interpret and may not be reproducible. In this paper, we ask whether an LLM can write a readable program for each topic that replaces its per-document judgments. To address these issues, we propose ExecJudges, a method for generating fast, inspectable and scalable judges for automatic relevance labeling. Specifically, ExecJudges uses a frontier LLM to turn assessment guidelines into executable programs, which rely only on lexical matching, standard NLP libraries like parsers, and pool statistics. An ExecJudges-L variant also uses examples of human labels if available. We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections by comparing the produced labels with trained NIST assessors, frontier LLM judges, and recently proposed per-topic classifiers. Our results show that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of the Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM judges on TREC DL 2019-2021. With a small number of human labels per topic, the ExecJudges-L variant agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers with the same labels on all seven collections, and either exceeds the agreement of LLM judges provided the same labels or is within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff's alpha. The labels rank the official TREC DL runs with Kendall's tau of 0.87 to 0.94, and writing the programs incurs a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic, with no additional costs for grading. Our results suggest that ExecJudges offers a reproducible, inspectable, efficient and cost-effective alternative to LLM judges for labeling deep result pools for system evaluation or ranking improvements.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)法官已经成为创建大规模相关判断以进行检索评价的一种常见方式. 然而,每项判决都要求对前沿模式发出可能代价高昂的呼吁,判决难以解释,可能无法复制。 在本文中,我们询问一个LLM是否能够为每个主题写一个可读的程序,以取代其每个文件的判断. 为了解决这些问题,我们提议设立执行法官,这是产生快速、可检查和可扩展法官的方法,以便自动贴上相关标签。 具体来说,ExecJudges使用边疆LLM将评估指南转化为可执行程序,它们只依赖词汇匹配,标准NLP库如解析器,以及集合统计. 一个ExecJudges-L变体如果有的话也会使用人类标签的例子. 我们通过将制作的标签与训练有素的NIST评审员、前沿LLM评审员以及最近提议的每个专题分类员进行比较,对TREC的7个汇编进行评估。 我们的结果显示,执行法官们同意NIST评估员在Claude Sonnet 5.5 LLM法官一级对TREC DL 2019-2021表示赞同。 ExecJudges-L变体每个主题都有少量的人类标签,它同意NIST多于所有7个集合都具有相同标签的每个主题分类器,或者超过LLM法官提供相同标签的协议,或者在Krippendorff的α中在其中约0.05. 标注为官方TREC DL的排名,肯德尔的tau为0.87至0.94,写作程序每题需一次性花费0.17至0.49美元,不需追加分级费用. 我们的结果表明,执行法官为LLM法官提供了一个可复制、可检查、高效和具有成本效益的替代办法,用于为系统评价或排名改进贴上深度成果库的标签。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Relevance judgments are essential for evaluating information retrieval systems. Obtaining them from human assessors is expensive and difficult to scale. Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative. Their relevance labels often approach the agreement between human assessors ( Thomas et al., 2024 ; Upadhyay et al., 2025 ) . However, relying on LLMs as relevance judges introduces several limitations. First, an expensive and often GPU-dependent model must evaluate each document. Assessment costs therefore grow with the size of the document pool and with every new retrieval run. Second, the decision process of an LLM judge is largely opaque. Even when the LLM provides an explanation, it is difficult to verify which criteria determined its judgment. Third, irrelevant or adversarial content can influence LLM judges. Query terms and instructions embedded in an assessed document are examples of such content ( Alaofi et al., 2024 ) . These limitations raise concerns about the reliability, reproducibility, and suitability of LLM-generated relevance judgments as substitutes for human assessments ( Faggioli et al., 2023 ; Soboroff, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 相关的判断对评估信息检索系统至关重要。 从人类评估员那里获得这些物品是昂贵的,而且难以衡量。 大型语言模型(LLMs)已经成为一种很有希望的替代品。 它们的相关性标签经常接近人类评审员之间的协议(Thomas等人,2024年;Upadhyay等人,2025年)。 然而,依靠法学硕士作为相关法官,带来了若干限制。 首先,一个昂贵而且往往依赖GPU的模型必须评价每个文件. 因此,评估费用随着文件库的规模和每次新的检索运行而增加。 第二,LLM法官的裁决程序基本上不透明。 即使LLM提供了解释,也难以核实决定其判断的标准是什么. 第三,无关或对抗性的内容可以影响LLM法官. 在评估文件中嵌入的查询术语和说明是此类内容的例子(Alaofi等人,2024年)。 这些限制使人们对LLM产生的相关判断作为人类评估的替代品的可靠性、可复制性和适用性感到关切(Faggioli等人,2023年;Soboroff,2025年)。

blocks.en: Relevance assessment involves repeatedly applying the same topic-specific criteria to different documents. For a given topic, assessors must determine whether a document addresses the requested subject, provides an answer, and satisfies the conditions for higher relevance grades. Although these criteria vary across topics, their interpretation and application need not be reconstructed independently for every document. Recent work on executable rubrics converts the natural-language evaluation criteria of LLM judges into explicit programs ( Dhole et al., 2026 ) . These programs replace repeated LLM judgments with deterministic scoring procedures that people can inspect. Motivated by this direction, we ask a related question for information retrieval: Can an LLM write a readable, generalizable relevance program for each topic that replaces its per-document relevance judgments? Such an approach could keep the topic-specific reasoning of LLMs. It would also reduce inference costs and make the assessment logic explicit and open to inspection.
blocks.zh: 相关性评估涉及对不同文件反复适用同样的专题标准。 对于某一主题,评估人员必须确定某一文件是否涉及所请求的主题,提供答案,并满足更高相关等级的条件。 虽然这些标准在不同的议题上各不相同,但是对每一文件的解释和适用不必独立地进行。 最近关于可执行主题的工作将LLM法官的自然语言评价标准转化为明确的程序(Dhole等人,2026年)。 这些方案用人们可以检查的确定性评分程序取代了重复的LLM判断. 基于这一方向,我们提出一个相关问题供检索: LLM能为每个主题写一个可读的,可概括的关联性程序,以取代其每份文件的相关判断吗? 这种做法可以保持法学硕士专题的特定推理。 这也将减少推论费用,使评估逻辑明确,并开放供检查。

blocks.en: We propose ExecJudges , a method that uses LLMs to generate topic-specific relevance assessors in the form of human-readable Python programs. Each program uses deterministic operations, including lexical matching, text parsing, and pool-level statistics, to evaluate the evidence needed for a relevance judgment. Two design choices distinguish our approach. First, the programs answer the conditions of the official assessment guidelines. These conditions include whether a passage is on topic, contains an answer, provides an exact answer, or is dedicated to the query. A fixed grading function then maps the answers to relevance grades. This function follows the structure of the assessment scale. Second, we generate several programs for each topic independently and average their grades. Averaging reduces the effect of errors in single programs and reduces over-grading. In this way, ExecJudges uses the LLM once per topic to construct a reusable assessment procedure. People can run, inspect and revise this procedure. Specifically, our contributions are: • We propose ExecJudges , a new method that uses an LLM to generate relevance-grading programs. The programs label deep document pools without further LLM calls. ExecJudges agrees with NIST at the level of the Sonnet judges on TREC DL 2019–2021 (Sections 3 and 5 ) at a one-time cost of $0.17 to $0.49 per topic. • We investigate adding a few human labels of each topic to the writer prompt. With 16 labels, ExecJudges -L agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers on all seven collections, and more than frontier LLM judges given the same labels on TREC DL 2019–2022 (Sections 3 and 5 ). • We show that ExecJudges ranks the systems similarly to the official ranking based on the NIST relevance labels with Kendall’s τ \tau of 0.87 to 0.94 (Sections 4 and 5 ). • We analyze the number of programs, per-topic and collection-level programs, rubric induction, and the choice of labeled examples (Section 6 ). Appendix C reports all prompts and labeling details.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ExecJudges(Exec Judges),这个方法使用LLMS以人可读的Python程序的形式生成针对特定主题的相关评估员. 每个程序都使用确定性操作,包括词汇匹配,文本解析,池级统计,来评价相关判断所需的证据. 两个设计选择 区别我们的方法。 首先,这些方案满足了官方评估准则的条件。 这些条件包括一个段落是针对主题的,包含一个答案,提供确切的答案,还是专用于查询. 固定的分级函数然后将答案映射到相关等级。 这一职能遵循分摊比额表的结构。 第二,我们独立地为每个题目制作几个节目,并平均他们的成绩。 演绎可以减少单个程序中错误的影响,减少超级. 这样,执行法官就利用每个专题一次的LLM来构建一个可重复使用的评估程序. 人们可以运行,检查和修改这一程序. 具体地说,我们的贡献是:我们提议执行法官,这是一种使用LLM生成相关性分级方案的新方法。 程序标签为深文档池, 不再使用 LLM 调用 。 执行法官同意在Sonnet法官一级就TREC DL 2019-2021(第3和第5节)与NIST达成协议,每个专题的一次性费用为0.17美元至0.49美元。 我们调查每个主题的几个人类标签 在作者的提示。 拥有16个标签,执行法官-L同意NIST在所有7个汇编中超过每个专题分类器,而且比前沿LLM法官同意TREC DL 2019–2022上的相同标签(第3和5节)。 我们显示,执行法官们根据NIST相关标签对系统进行类似的排名,Kendall的#\tau为0.87至0.94(第4和第5节)。 我们分析程序的数量、每个专题和收集级别的程序、标题感应和标签示例的选择(第6节)。 附 录 C报告所有的提示和标签细节.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: We now review related work to contextualize our contributions.
blocks.zh: 我们现在审查相关工作,以根据具体情况确定我们的贡献。

blocks.en: LLM relevance judges: The past few years have seen an increasing use of large language models (LLMs) as automated relevance assessors. Faggioli et al. ( Faggioli et al., 2023 ) provided an early framework for LLM-based relevance judgment. Their framework outlines a spectrum of human-LLM collaboration from human-assisted assessment to fully automated evaluation. Thomas et al. (2024) showed that LLMs can predict searcher preferences. Their LLM relevance judgments were comparable to those of human assessors at a much lower annotation cost. Subsequently, Upadhyay et al. ( Upadhyay et al., 2025 ) introduced UMBRELA, an open-source relevance assessment framework based on GPT-4o. UMBRELA reproduced the Bing relevance assessment method and showed promising results on the TREC Deep Learning benchmarks. Others extended automated assessment to retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ( Thakur et al., 2025 ; Dhole et al., 2025 ) by comparing LLMs with human judges. ExecJudges uses the same guidelines as these judges and removes the per-document model call.
blocks.zh: LLM相关法官: 在过去几年中,人们越来越多地使用大型语言模型作为自动相关性评估员。 Faggioli等人著. (Faggioli等人,2023年)为基于LLM的关联性判断提供了早期框架. 其框架概述了从人力援助评估到完全自动化评价等一系列人与LLM合作。 Thomas等人(2024年)表明LLMS可以预测搜索者的偏好. 其与LLM相关的判断与人类评估员的判断相当,其注释成本要低得多。 随后,Upadhyay et al. (Upadhyay等人,2025年)引入了基于GPT-4o的开源相关性评估框架UMBRELA. UMBRELA转载了Bing相关性评估方法,并在TREC深层学习基准上显示出有希望的结果. 另一些国家则通过比较法学硕士与人类法官的情况,将自动评估扩大到检索强化生成(RAG)(Thakur等人,2025年;Dhole等人,2025年)。 执行法官使用与这些法官相同的准则,并删除每个文件的模型调用.

blocks.en: Per-topic relevance assessment: Prior work has explored topic-specific supervision and artifacts to improve relevance assessment. Gienapp et al. ( Gienapp et al., 2026 ) train lightweight classifiers on 64–256 human judgments per topic. These classifiers agree with human assessors more than prompted LLMs. They need topic-specific annotations. Otero et al. ( Otero and Parapar, 2026 ) generate a reusable relevance description for each topic. An LLM then applies this description to judge documents. Farzi et al. ( Farzi and Dietz, 2024 ) use per-query exam questions to grade passages. RubricRAG ( Dhole and Agichtein, 2026 ) retrieves related rubrics to generate query-specific evaluation criteria. Qworld ( Su et al., 2026 ) recursively generates fine-grained, question-specific evaluation criteria for LLM responses. Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2023 ) generate topic-specific Boolean queries that provide high-precision but low-recall filtering. These approaches prepare labels, examples or other artifacts for each topic. Most of them still apply a model to every document.
blocks.zh: 专题相关性评估: 以前的工作探索了针对特定专题的监督和文物,以改进相关性评估。 Gienapp 等 (英语). (Gienapp et al., 2026) 训练轻量级人员对每个题目进行64-256人判断. 这些分类员与人类评审员的认同程度超过诱导的LLM. 它们需要专题说明。 奥特罗等人. (Otero and Parapar, 2026)生成每个专题的可重复使用的相关描述. 然后,用LLM来判断文件。 法尔济等. (Farzi and Dietz, 2024) 使用每格考试题进行分级考试. RubricRAG (Dhole and Agichtein, 2026) 检索相关的标题以生成特定查询的评价标准. Qworld(Su等人,2026年) 递归生成精细,针对特定问题的LLM响应评价标准. 王等编. (Wang et al., 2023)生成针对特定主题的布尔查询,提供高精度但低调的过滤. 这些方法为每个专题准备标签、实例或其他文物。 其中大多数文件仍然对每份文件采用一个模型。

blocks.en: Limitations of LLMs as relevance assessors: LLM relevance judges also have known limitations. Soboroff ( Soboroff, 2025 ) argued against relying on LLM-generated judgments for TREC-style evaluations. He emphasized the importance of independent human assessments. Similarly, Clarke and Dietz ( Clarke and Dietz, 2025 ) highlighted fundamental limitations such as susceptibility to evaluation gaming, circularity, and distorted system rankings. Two practical problems have received less attention. LLM relevance assessments are hard to interpret. Their computational cost makes large-scale assessment slow and expensive.
blocks.zh: 法学硕士作为相关评审员的限制:法学硕士的相关法官也有已知的限制。 Soboroff(Soboroff,2025年)反对依靠LLM生成的判决进行TREC式评价。 他强调了独立人力评估的重要性。 同样,Clarke和Dietz(Clarke和Dietz,2025年)也强调了一些基本限制,例如易被评价游戏、循环性和扭曲的系统排名。 两个实际问题受到的关注较少。 LLM相关性评估很难解释. 它们的计算成本使得大规模评估缓慢而昂贵.

blocks.en: Symbolic distillation and program synthesis: A parallel line of work distills the behavior of black-box models into explicit symbolic rules. Examples include circuit discovery ( Rai et al., 2026 ) , symbolic models distilled from trained networks ( Cranmer et al., 2020 ) , and the translation of predictions into rules or reasoning trails ( Armgaan et al., 2024 ; Rorseth et al., 2026 ) . Most of these methods fit rules to a trained model or to its predictions. More recent methods have an LLM write programs directly. ALCHEmist ( Huang et al., 2024 ) has an LLM write labeling programs for classification tasks to label data without model calls. Most recently, Dhole et al. (2026) translated natural-language rubrics into executable Python rubrics to give faster and verifiable preference annotations of long-form responses. Unlike previous works, ExecJudges uses an LLM to convert general assessment guidelines into labeling programs, without requiring explicit per-topic rubrics or LLM relevance labels.
blocks.zh: 符号蒸馏与程序合成: 平行的工作线将黑盒模型的行为提炼成明确的象征规则. 实例包括电路发现(Rai等人,2026年),从训练有素的网络中提炼出来的象征性模型(Cranmer等人,2020年),以及将预测转化为规则或推理线索(Armgaan等人,2024年;Roreth等人,2026年). 这些方法大多与训练有素的模型或其预测相符。 较近期的方法有LLM直接写入程序. ALCHEMist(Huang等人,2024年)有一个LLM写标签程序,用于分类任务,在没有模型调用的情况下给数据贴标签. 最近,Dhole等人(2026年)将自然语言的rubics翻译为可执行的Python rubics,对长式响应给出更快和可核实的偏好说明. 与之前的作品不同,ExecJudges使用LLM将一般评估准则转换为标签程序,而不需要明确的每个专题标题或LLM相关标签.

blocks.en: 3. The ExecJudges Method
blocks.zh: 3个 执行法官 方法

blocks.en: ExecJudges replaces the per-document calls of an LLM judge with programs that an LLM writes once for each topic.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges用一个LLM为每个话题写过一次的程序来取代一个LLM法官的每份文件通话.

blocks.en: 3.1. Writer inputs and tools
blocks.zh: 3.1. 作家的投入和工具

blocks.en: • Topic information: The topic as presented to the human assessors, consisting of the query for TREC Deep Learning, and the title, description, and narrative for TREC-COVID and Robust04. • Relevance grading guidelines: The official assessor grade definitions, reproduced verbatim from the corresponding track guidelines. • Grade distribution: A calibration statement that gives the share of each relevance grade. For DL 2019 and 2020, the shares come from the NIST labels of the DL 2019 and 2020 topics. For the other collections, they come from the example topics. • Labeled examples: One NIST-labeled passage per relevance grade from each of a few example topics of the same collection. We use three example topics. DL 2020 uses the DL 2019 example topics. Topics included in the prompt or used for training are excluded from all evaluations. • Unlabeled examples: A few unlabeled passages sampled from the target topic’s document pool to illustrate the input text format. We use five passages. • Tool-use policy: A specification of the permitted libraries, operations, and execution constraints for the generated programs.
blocks.zh: • 专题资料: 向人类评估员介绍的专题包括TREC深层学习的查询,以及TREC-COVID和Robust04的标题、描述和说明。 • 相关性评级准则: 正式评估员职等定义,逐字转载自相应的轨道准则。 • 支助 职等分布: 校准语句,给出每个相关级别的比例. 对于DL 2019年和2020年,股份来自DL 2019年和2020年主题的NIST标签. 对于其他的集合来说,它们来自实例主题. • 标签上的例子: 从同一集的几个例子专题中,每个相关级别都有一个NIST标记的段落。 我们用三个例子。 DL 2020使用DL 2019实例话题. 所有评价都不包括及时列入或用于培训的专题。 • 未加标签的例子: 从目标主题的文件库中抽取了一些未加标签的段落,以说明输入文本格式。 我们用五个段落。 工具使用政策: 描述允许生成程序的图书馆、操作和执行限制。

blocks.en: Topic information: The topic as presented to the human assessors, consisting of the query for TREC Deep Learning, and the title, description, and narrative for TREC-COVID and Robust04.
blocks.zh: 专题信息: 向人类评估员介绍的专题包括TREC深层学习的查询,以及TREC-COVID和Robust04的标题、描述和说明。

blocks.en: Relevance grading guidelines: The official assessor grade definitions, reproduced verbatim from the corresponding track guidelines.
blocks.zh: 相关性分级准则: 正式评估员职等定义,逐字转载自相应的轨道准则。

blocks.en: Grade distribution: A calibration statement that gives the share of each relevance grade. For DL 2019 and 2020, the shares come from the NIST labels of the DL 2019 and 2020 topics. For the other collections, they come from the example topics.
blocks.zh: 职等分布: 校准语句,给出每个相关级别的比例. 对于DL 2019年和2020年,股份来自DL 2019年和2020年主题的NIST标签. 对于其他的集合来说,它们来自实例主题.

blocks.en: Labeled examples: One NIST-labeled passage per relevance grade from each of a few example topics of the same collection. We use three example topics. DL 2020 uses the DL 2019 example topics. Topics included in the prompt or used for training are excluded from all evaluations.
blocks.zh: 标签示例 : 从同一集的几个例子专题中,每个相关级别都有一个NIST标记的段落。 我们用三个例子。 DL 2020使用DL 2019实例话题. 所有评价都不包括及时列入或用于培训的专题。

blocks.en: Unlabeled examples: A few unlabeled passages sampled from the target topic’s document pool to illustrate the input text format. We use five passages.
blocks.zh: 未标记的例子 : 从目标主题的文件库中抽取了一些未加标签的段落,以说明输入文本格式。 我们用五个段落。

blocks.en: Tool-use policy: A specification of the permitted libraries, operations, and execution constraints for the generated programs.
blocks.zh: 工具使用政策: 描述允许生成程序的图书馆、操作和执行限制。

blocks.en: The prompt contains only a few examples. This choice follows the in-context learning literature, in which three to five examples have been shown to be a successful setting for code generation tasks ( Austin et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Oskooei et al., 2025 ) . The grade distribution statement follows the guidance on instructing non-expert assessors with clear calibration and mapping of utility to relevance levels ( Sormunen, 2002 ; Alonso and Mizzaro, 2012 ) . Without ExecJudges -L labels, the program writer never sees a relevance label of the topic for which it writes a program.
blocks.zh: 提示只包含几个例子. 这一选择遵循了内文学习文献,其中三到五个例子被证明是代码生成任务的成功设置(Austin等人,2021年;Li等人,2024年;Oskooei等人,2025年). 职等分配说明遵循指导非专家评估员明确校准和绘制实用性图以达到相关水平的准则(Sormunen,2002年;Alonso和Mizzaro,2012年)。 没有执行法官 -L标签,程序编写者从未看到它为其撰写程序的主题的相关标签.

blocks.en: The programs use only deterministic, lightweight operations. Grading is therefore cheap and gives the same labels on every run. The programs may call the Python standard library and a small toolkit. The toolkit tokenizes text with Snowball stemming. It computes BM25 scores and percentiles within the pool of the topic ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) . It also matches phrases within a window, splits sentences, and parses numbers, dates and units. Two helpers measure how much of a passage supports given terms and how much of it is unrelated text. The programs run in a sandbox with time and memory limits. The sandbox blocks network access and model calls.
blocks.zh: 程序只使用定型,轻量级操作. 因此,分级是便宜的,每跑一次都给同样的标签. 程序可以称为Python标准库和一个小工具包. 工具箱将文本与雪球结晶联系起来。 它计算了BM25的得分和该主题集合中的百分位数(Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009). 它还匹配窗口内的短语,分割句子,以及解析数字,日期和单位. 两个帮助者衡量一段支持给定条款的多少,以及其中多少是无关的文本. 程序在一个有时间和内存限制的沙盒中运行. 沙盒屏蔽网络接入和模型调用.

blocks.en: 3.2. Program structure and consensus labeling
blocks.zh: 3.2. 方案结构和协商一致标签

blocks.en: Each program answers the questions that the official grade definitions pose about a document. A fixed formula then maps the answers to a grade. For example, for the query when was the salvation army founded , a program checks whether a passage is about the Salvation Army, whether it states when the organization was founded, and whether it is mainly about this question. Figure 2 shows this topic. This design keeps the grading scale outside the generated code. The writer only decides what counts as evidence for each question.
blocks.zh: 每个程序都会回答官方等级定义对文档提出的问题. 固定公式然后将答案映射到一个等级。 例如,对于救世军何时建立的问题,一个程序检查一条通道是否与救世军有关,它是否说明组织成立时,以及它是否主要涉及这个问题. 图2显示了这一主题。 此设计将分级尺度保留在生成代码之外. 作者只决定什么是每个问题的证据。

blocks.en: Each program defines one function, assess . This function receives the query and the whole pool of the topic. It returns one record of answers for each document. On the 0–3 scale of TREC Deep Learning, the answers are on_subject , some_answer , exact_answer and dedicated . The formula follows the NIST definitions. A passage that is not on the subject gets grade 0. A passage on the subject without an answer gets grade 1. A passage with an exact answer that is dedicated to the query gets grade 3. Every other passage gets grade 2. On the 0–2 scales of TREC-COVID and Robust04, the answers are relevant and key . These two answers correspond to the definitions of grades 1 and 2 in the track guidelines. The prompt asks the writer to set an answer to true only on explicit evidence. Missing evidence therefore lowers the grade.
blocks.zh: 每个程序定义一个函数,评估. 此函数接收到该主题的查询和整个集合 。 它返回每个文档的答案记录。 在 TREC 深层学习的 0–3 尺度上, 答案在_subject, some_answer, 准确_answer and dependent. 该公式遵循NIST定义. 一个不是这个话题的段落得到等级 0. 有关这个主题的段落,没有答案就获得等级 1. 带准确答案的段落,专门用于查询,得到分级 3. 其他每一段都有等级 2. 在TREC-COVID和Robust04的0-2尺度上,答案是相关和关键的。 这两个答案与田径指南中的1级和2级的定义相对应. 提示要求作者只根据明确的证据来给出一个真实的答案. 因此,缺失的证据降低了等级。

blocks.en: We run each new program on test passages from the pool. If the program fails or violates the tool policy, the writer gets one chance to repair it. We allow a single repair attempt, mainly to handle possible API or connection timeouts.
blocks.zh: 我们在泳池的测试通道上运行每个新程序. 如果程序失败或违反工具政策,编剧获得一次修复的机会. 我们允许一次修复尝试,主要是处理可能的API或连接超时.

blocks.en: ExecJudges labels a document with the consensus of several independently written programs. Single programs make different errors and tend to grade too high. Averaging their grades reduces both effects. Specifically, the writer writes k k programs independently from the same prompt. Program i i assigns the grade g i ​ ( d ) g_{i}(d) to document d d . The label of the document is the mean grade, rounded down: ℓ ⁡ ( d ) = ⌊ 1 k ​ ∑ i = 1 k g i ​ ( d ) ⌋ \ell(d)=\lfloor\frac{1}{k}\sum_{i=1}^{k}g_{i}(d)\rfloor . Our implementation uses k = 3 k=3 , because more programs added little agreement in our experiments on the development and pilot collections (Section 6 ). We chose the rounding rule after a control experiment on the same collections. Appendix B describes this experiment. We fixed k k and the rounding rule before any run on the test collections. Figure 2 shows the main method on one DL 2019 topic.

blocks.en: 3.3. Optional topic labels
blocks.zh: 3.3. 可选主题标签

blocks.en: When a few human labels of a topic exist, ExecJudges -L uses them to show the writer where the assessors drew the lines between the grades. The writer prompt then contains a small set of judged passages of the topic with their NIST grades. The prompt asks the writer to encode general rules that give these passages their grades. The rules must not refer to the passages by their wording. Everything else is the same as in the main method. The programs grade every passage of the pool, including the labeled passages.
blocks.zh: 当存在一些关于某一主题的人类标签时,ExecJudges -L使用这些标签来向编剧展示评委在成绩之间划线的位置. 编剧的提示随后包含了一套带有其NIST成绩的对主题的评断段落. 提示要求写作者编码给这些段落分级的一般规则. 规则不得以措辞提及段落。 其他一切如来主法中. 程序对游泳池的每一段进行分级,包括标注的段落.

blocks.en: We compare two ways to choose the passages to label. The first shows how much labels can help. The second is one that an assessor could apply in practice. Stratified sampling takes the same number of passages from each NIST grade. Our implementation uses 1 to 4 passages per grade, for 4 to 16 labels per topic. Our implementation uses 5 passages per grade plus one passage from the largest grade to reach 16 labels on the 0–2 collections. Smaller label sets are subsets of larger ones. Stratified sampling uses the NIST grades. It therefore measures how much a given number of labels can help. BM25 top k k labels the k k judged passages with the highest BM25 scores. An assessor who judges the top of a lexical ranking would label these passages first. Our implementation uses k = 3 k=3 for ExecJudges -L, following the same in-context learning setting of three to five examples, and k = 16 k=16 and k = 64 k=64 for the classifier. The original classifier paper uses 64 labels as its smallest training size. When we use ExecJudges -L labels as qrels, the labeled passages keep their human grades.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了两种选择段落与标签的方法. 第一个显示标签能帮助多少. 第二个是评估人员在实践中可以应用的。 分级采样从每个NIST等级中取出相同数量的通道. 我们的实施工作采用每级1至4段,每个题目4至16个标签。 我们的实施工作使用每级5个段落,加上从最高年级到0-2集的16个标签。 较小的标签集是较大的标签集的子集. 分级抽样采用NIST分级. 因此,它衡量一定数量的标签能帮助多少。 BM25顶级Kk标注了BM25分数最高的K判断段落. 一位评选名词排名最高的评审员会先标注这些段落. 我们的实施工作使用k=3 k=3的ExecJudges -L,遵循3至5个实例的相同内文学习设置,K=16 k=16,K=64 k=64的分类器. 最初的分类纸使用64个标签作为其最小的训练尺寸. 当我们使用ExecJudges -L标签作为qrels时,标注的段落保持了人类的成绩.

blocks.en: 3.4. Ablation variants
blocks.zh: 3.4. 通缩变体

blocks.en: Two variants test the main design choices of a per-topic program. ExecJudges -1P tests the value of averaging. It uses only the first program of each topic. ExecJudges -R tests whether an explicit rubric helps. Its writer first induces 3 to 9 criteria for the topic. Each criterion carries the grade level that requires it. The writer then writes one check function per criterion. The grade is the highest level whose criteria all pass.
blocks.zh: 两个变体测试了每个专题程序的主要设计选择. 执行法官 - 1P 测试平均值 。 它只使用每个主题的第一个程序. ExecJudges - R 测试一个明确的标题是否有帮助 。 其编剧首先引领了3至9项关于这个主题的标准. 每个标准都具有要求的级别。 作者然后按标准写一个检查函数. 等级是最高等级,其标准全部通过.

blocks.en: Two further variants test whether the programs must be specific to a topic. ExecJudges -Global is one program for all topics. ExecJudges -GR is one rubric with one set of check functions for all topics. These two variants label new topics without any LLM call.
blocks.zh: 还有两种变体测试程序是否必须针对一个主题。 ExecJudges - Global是一个针对所有主题的方案. ExecJudges - GR 是一个标题,包含一套检查所有主题的功能. 这两个变体在没有任何LLM调用的情况下标注了新的话题.

blocks.en: 4. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4. 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate ExecJudges on seven TREC collections against LLM judges and supervised per-topic methods, by label agreement, system-ranking agreement and cost.
blocks.zh: 我们通过标签协议、系统级协议和费用,对TREC的七份汇编进行针对LLM法官的评价,并监督每个专题的方法。

blocks.en: 4.1. Collections and protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1. 收藏和礼宾

blocks.en: We divide the collections into development, pilot and test collections. This division ensures that the test results do not depend on choices made during method design. DL 2019 and 2020 ( Craswell et al., 2019 ; Craswell et al., 2020 ) serve for development. DL 2021 ( Craswell et al., 2021 ) serves as the pilot test. The test collections are DL 2022 ( Craswell et al., 2022 ) , DL 2023 ( Craswell et al., 2023 ) , TREC-COVID ( Voorhees et al., 2020 ) and Robust04 ( Voorhees, 2004 ) . DL grades range from 0 to 3. TREC-COVID and Robust04 grades range from 0 to 2. We load all collections with ir_datasets ( MacAvaney et al., 2021 ) . We evaluate every method on the same topics. Table 14 in Appendix C gives the size of each collection. The same appendix lists the topics that we excluded and the reasons.
blocks.zh: 我们把藏品分为开发、试验和试验藏品。 这种划分确保测试结果不取决于方法设计期间所作的选择。 DL 2019年和2020年(Craswell等人,2019年;Craswell等人,2020年)服务于发展. DL 2021 (Craswell et al., 2021)作为试飞试验. 测试收集有DL 2022(Craswell等人,2022年),DL 2023(Craswell等人,2023年),TREC-COVID(Voorhees等人,2020年)和Robust04(Voorhees,2004年). DL的成绩从0到3不等. TREC-COVID和Robust04的成绩在0到2之间. 我们用ir_dataset(MacAvaney等人,2021年)加载所有收藏. 我们评价同样的题目上的每一种方法。 附录中的表14 C给出每集的大小. 同一附录列出了我们排除的议题和理由。

blocks.en: We separated prompt development from testing. We developed the program writer prompts on the development collections and then froze them. DL 2021 served as the pilot test. Appendix B lists the changes that we made after the pilot. We ran ExecJudges and ExecJudges -L once on each test collection with the frozen prompts. The runs marked † in Table 1 were made separately, once each. For DL 2023, we have only these separate runs. API costs use October 2026 prices.
blocks.zh: 我们把快速发展与测试分开了 我们开发了程序作者 提示开发集,然后冻结它们。 DL 2021担任试飞员. 附 录 B列出了我们在飞行员之后所做的改变。 我们运行了Exec Judges和Exec Judges - L一次在每次测试收集 与冻结的提示。 表1中标有“________________________________________________________________________________ 对于DL 2023,我们只有这些单独的运行。 API成本使用2026年10月的价格.

blocks.en: 4.2. Baselines

We compare ExecJudges with LLM judges, with supervised per-topic methods, and with baselines that use no LLM. All baselines label the same passages as ExecJudges . The label-based baselines receive the same labels as ExecJudges -L.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了执行法官与LLM法官、受监督的每个专题方法以及没有LLM的基线。 所有基线都标注与执行法官相同的段落。 基于标签的基线得到与ExecJudges -L相同的标签.

blocks.en: • LLM judges : We use Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 as judges. The judges receive the same inputs as the program writer. The pointwise judge uses the UMBRELA prompt ( Upadhyay et al., 2025 ) with one passage per call. The listwise judge grades a numbered list of up to 100 passages of the pool per request. Table 1 reports the listwise Sonnet judge on all collections. Section 4.1 describes which of these runs were made separately. • LLM judges with topic labels : These are the same judges with the labeled passages of ExecJudges -L added to the prompt. • Topic classifier ( Gienapp et al., 2026 ) : The tables call this baseline Classifier. It trains one LoRA adapter per topic on monoT5-base with the same labels as ExecJudges -L. With the released training settings, it labels almost every passage relevant. We therefore tuned three settings on 8 DL 2019 topics. This tuning favors the classifier on DL 2019. Appendix B gives the details. • One-shot labeling ( MacAvaney and Soldaini, 2023 ) : The tables call this baseline One-shot. DuoT5-3B compares each passage with the highest-graded passage of the 16-label set, as in the released autoqrels code. Cut points turn the DuoT5 score into grades. One-shot (1) fits the cut points on the labeled passages of other collections. One-shot (16) fits them on the 16 labels of the topic. One-shot labeling was designed to label the unjudged documents of a pool. Our reuse experiment tests it in that use. On Robust04 and TREC-COVID, we cut each document to its first 230 tokens. This cut keeps both documents within the 512-token input of the released code. • Without an LLM : BM25 cutoffs rank the pool by BM25 and cut the ranking at the grade proportions of the example topics. Embedding cutoffs apply the same cut to the cosine similarity of bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) . The lexical classifier is a logistic regression on the features of our toolkit. We train it on the Sonnet labels of DL 2019 and 2020.
blocks.zh: • LLM法官: 我们用克劳德·索内特·5.5和克劳德·海库·5.5作为法官。 评委得到与节目编剧相同的投入. 指针判官使用UMBRELA的速报(Upadhyay等人,2025年),每通呼叫一次. 依名单判断成绩,每个请求最多100段的成绩。 表1列出索内法官关于所有收藏的资料。 第4.1节说明其中哪些是单独进行的。 • 具有专题标签的LLM法官: 这些法官与标注为ExecJudges - L的段落相同。 • 专题分类器(Gienapp等人,2026年): 这些表格称为这一基线分类符。 它在单T5基上每个话题培训一个LORA适配器,其标签与ExecJudges - L相同。 在发布的训练设置下,它几乎给每个相关段落贴标签。 因此,我们调整了8个DL 2019主题的三个设置。 这个调音有利于DL 2019上的分类器. 附录B提供了详细情况。 • 一发标签(MacAvaney和Soldaini,2023年) 各表称本基线为"一射". DuoT5-3B将每段路段与16-label集最高等级的路段进行比较,如发行的autoqrels代码. 切点将DuoT5分数变为分数. 一弹一弹(1)符合其他藏品标注段落上的切点. 一弹一弹(16)符合这个主题的16个标签. 一发标签是为了给一个游泳池的未判断文件贴标签。 我们的再利用实验 测试它在那个用途。 在Robust04和TREC-COVID上,我们把每个文件剪到它的前230个符号. 这个剪切将两个文件都保存在已发行代码的512托肯输入内. • 支助 没有LLM : BM25断档以 BM25 排行榜,并按例题的等级比例削减排名. 嵌入切片对bge-small-en-v1.5嵌入的余弦相似性适用相同的切片(Xiao等人,2024年). 语法分类器是对我们工具包特征的逻辑回归。 我们在Sonnet的标签上训练它,DL 2019和2020.

blocks.en: LLM judges : We use Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5 as judges. The judges receive the same inputs as the program writer. The pointwise judge uses the UMBRELA prompt ( Upadhyay et al., 2025 ) with one passage per call. The listwise judge grades a numbered list of up to 100 passages of the pool per request. Table 1 reports the listwise Sonnet judge on all collections. Section 4.1 describes which of these runs were made separately.
blocks.zh: LLM法官: 我们用克劳德·索内特·5.5和克劳德·海库·5.5作为法官。 评委得到与节目编剧相同的投入. 指针判官使用UMBRELA的速报(Upadhyay等人,2025年),每通呼叫一次. 依名单判断成绩,每个请求最多100段的成绩。 表1列出索内法官关于所有收藏的资料。 第4.1节说明其中哪些是单独进行的。

blocks.en: LLM judges with topic labels : These are the same judges with the labeled passages of ExecJudges -L added to the prompt.
blocks.zh: 具有主题标签的LLM评委: 这些法官与标注为ExecJudges - L的段落相同。

blocks.en: Topic classifier ( Gienapp et al., 2026 ) : The tables call this baseline Classifier. It trains one LoRA adapter per topic on monoT5-base with the same labels as ExecJudges -L. With the released training settings, it labels almost every passage relevant. We therefore tuned three settings on 8 DL 2019 topics. This tuning favors the classifier on DL 2019. Appendix B gives the details.
blocks.zh: 主题分类器 (Gienapp等人,2026年) (中文(简体) ). 这些表格称为这一基线分类符。 它在单T5基上每个话题培训一个LORA适配器,其标签与ExecJudges - L相同。 在发布的训练设置下,它几乎给每个相关段落贴标签。 因此,我们调整了8个DL 2019主题的三个设置。 这个调音有利于DL 2019上的分类器. 附录B提供了详细情况。

blocks.en: One-shot labeling ( MacAvaney and Soldaini, 2023 ) : The tables call this baseline One-shot. DuoT5-3B compares each passage with the highest-graded passage of the 16-label set, as in the released autoqrels code. Cut points turn the DuoT5 score into grades. One-shot (1) fits the cut points on the labeled passages of other collections. One-shot (16) fits them on the 16 labels of the topic. One-shot labeling was designed to label the unjudged documents of a pool. Our reuse experiment tests it in that use. On Robust04 and TREC-COVID, we cut each document to its first 230 tokens. This cut keeps both documents within the 512-token input of the released code.
blocks.zh: 一发标签 (麦克阿瓦尼和索尔达尼,2023年): 各表称本基线为"一射". DuoT5-3B将每段路段与16-label集最高等级的路段进行比较,如发行的autoqrels代码. 切点将DuoT5分数变为分数. 一弹一弹(1)符合其他藏品标注段落上的切点. 一弹一弹(16)符合这个主题的16个标签. 一发标签是为了给一个游泳池的未判断文件贴标签。 我们的再利用实验 测试它在那个用途。 在Robust04和TREC-COVID上,我们把每个文件剪到它的前230个符号. 这个剪切将两个文件都保存在已发行代码的512托肯输入内.

blocks.en: Without an LLM : BM25 cutoffs rank the pool by BM25 and cut the ranking at the grade proportions of the example topics. Embedding cutoffs apply the same cut to the cosine similarity of bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) . The lexical classifier is a logistic regression on the features of our toolkit. We train it on the Sonnet labels of DL 2019 and 2020.
blocks.zh: 没有LLM : BM25断档以 BM25 排行榜,并按例题的等级比例削减排名. 嵌入切片对bge-small-en-v1.5嵌入的余弦相似性适用相同的切片(Xiao等人,2024年). 语法分类器是对我们工具包特征的逻辑回归。 我们在Sonnet的标签上训练它,DL 2019和2020.

blocks.en: The supervised baselines and ExecJudges -L use the labels in different ways. The supervised baselines fit a model or cut points to the labels. The program writer uses the labels to adjust rules that it derives from the grading guidelines.
blocks.zh: 受监督的基线和执行法官-L以不同方式使用标签。 受监督的基线符合模型或切点标记。 程序编写器使用标签来调整它从分级准则中产生的规则.

blocks.en: 4.3. Measures

We measure label agreement with ordinal Krippendorff’s α \alpha ( Krippendorff, 2018 ) . Gienapp et al. use binary α \alpha at grade ≥ \geq 1. We also report this measure. We pool agreement over all evaluation passages of a collection. No method is evaluated on a passage whose label it saw. Our implementation uses the residual passages for evaluation: the judged passages of each topic without its 16 stratified labels and its BM25 top passages, 3 on DL 2019–2021 and 16 on the test collections.

blocks.en: 5. Results
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结果

blocks.en: Programs written once per topic reach the label agreement of frontier LLM judges on TREC DL and exceed supervised per-topic methods when a few labels are available.
blocks.zh: 一旦每个专题编写的程序达到前沿LLM法官关于TREC DL的标签协议,并在有少数标签时超过受监督的每个专题方法。

blocks.en: Table 1. Main results: ordinal α \alpha against NIST. Sonnet is the listwise judge. Stars: against ExecJudges (no labels) or ExecJudges -L (16 labels). † Separate single runs on matched passages, without tests. TREC-COVID: 36 topics with labels. –: not run.
blocks.zh: 表1. 主要结果:正统α-α对NIST. 索内特是法官 明星:反对执行法官(没有标签)或执行法官-L(16个标签). * 单独运行在匹配的通道上,没有测试。 TREC-COVID:36个有标签的主题 –:不运行.

blocks.en: 5.1. Main results
blocks.zh: 5.1. 主要成果

blocks.en: Without labels, ExecJudges agrees with NIST labels at the level of the Sonnet judges on the development and pilot collections. Its differences from the pointwise and listwise Sonnet judges are within the confidence intervals on DL 2019–2021. On DL 2019–2022, ExecJudges is within 0.054 of the listwise Sonnet judge. It is below this judge on DL 2023, Robust04 and TREC-COVID. Table 1 shows these results. Tables 7 and 10 in Appendix A list the intervals. Without labels, the writer has to infer from the guidelines alone where the assessors drew the lines between the grades. Section 5.2 shows that a few labels of the topic supply this information.
blocks.zh: 没有标签,ExecJudges同意Sonnet级法官的NIST标签在开发和试点收藏上. 其与指向和列表的Sonnet评委的差异在DL 2019–2021的置信间隔内. 在DL 2019–2022上,执行法官在列表中Sonnet法官的0.054之内. 在DL 2023号、Robust04号和TREC-COVID号上,它低于这位法官。 表1显示了这些结果。 附录A的表7和表10列出了间隔。 没有标签,作者只能从准则中推断出评委在等级之间划线的情况. 第5.2节表明,本专题的一些标签提供了这一信息。

blocks.en: Table 2. Test collections: ordinal / binary α \alpha on the documents that the pointwise Sonnet judge labeled. (16): 16 labels per topic. Stars: against Sonnet.
blocks.zh: 表2. 测试集:指针Sonnet判断标注的文档上的正数 / 二进制 α\ alpha. (16):每个话题16个标签. 明星:反对索内.

blocks.en: A significance test on the test collections confirms this order. We compare ExecJudges with the pointwise Sonnet judge on the documents that the judge labeled. Without labels, ExecJudges is significantly below the judge on DL 2022, Robust04 and TREC-COVID at p < 0.05 p<0.05 . With labels, ExecJudges -L is significantly above the judge on DL 2022. Its differences from the judge on Robust04 and TREC-COVID are not significant. Table 2 lists these results, with binary α \alpha . With labels, the programs are therefore no longer significantly below the judge on any of these collections.
blocks.zh: 在测试集合上进行的意义测试证实了这个顺序. 我们比较了执行法官与Sonnet法官对法官标注的文件的判断。 在没有标签的情况下,执行法官在DL 2022、Robust04和TREC-COVID上明显低于法官在p < 0.05 p < 0.05。 有标签的,执行法官 -L在DL2022上明显高于法官 它与法官在Robust04和TREC-COVID上的区别不大. 表2列出了这些结果,并附有二进制α\α. 因此,只要贴上标签,程序就不再明显低于法官对其中任何收藏的评断。

blocks.en: ExecJudges -L agrees with NIST labels more than an LLM judge with the same labels on TREC DL. On DL 2019–2022, ExecJudges -L is above the listwise Sonnet judge with the same labels by 0.037 to 0.130. On Robust04 and TREC-COVID, it is below this judge by about 0.05. Table 1 shows these results, including the values with larger label sets. Both document collections have long documents and topics with narratives. Relevant documents are also rare on Robust04. These conditions appear to be harder for lexical programs than passage ranking.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges - L同意NIST标签多于在TREC DL上有相同标签的LLM法官. DL 2019–2022上,执行法官 -L比Sonnet的评委高0.037到0.130 在Robust04和TREC-COVID上,它低于这个法官大约0.05。 表1显示了这些结果,包括带有较大标签的数值。 两个文件集都有长篇文件和主题,有叙述. 相关文件在Robust04上也很罕见. 这些条件似乎比通过排名更难于适用于词汇程序.

blocks.en: With the same human labels, ExecJudges -L agrees with NIST labels more than both supervised baselines on every collection. This result holds for passage and document collections and for both grading scales. All three methods receive the same 16 labels per topic. The difference from the classifier is significant on five of the seven collections. The exceptions are DL 2019 and DL 2023. The DL 2023 value of ExecJudges -L comes from a separate run without a test. The difference from One-shot is significant on all six collections where we ran One-shot. Table 1 shows these results. Table 4 in Appendix A gives binary α \alpha for the same methods. A likely reason is that 16 labels are too few to fit a supervised model and its cut points. The program writer uses the labels only to adjust rules that it derives from the grading guidelines. The analysis of the cut points in Section 5.3 supports this explanation.
blocks.zh: 使用相同的人类标签,ExecJudges -L与NIST标签的一致程度超过每个收藏的受监督的基线。 这一结果适用于通过和文件收集以及两个等级表。 所有三种方法每个话题都得到同样的16个标签. 与分类器的区别在七集中的五集中显著. 例外为DL 2019和DL 2023. ExecJudges -L的DL 2023值来自没有测试的单独运行. 与One-shot的区别在我们运行One-shot的所有六部作品中都是显著的. 表1显示了这些结果。 附录表4 A为相同方法给出二进制 α\ alpha 。 一个可能的原因是,16个标签太少,不适合一个有监督的模型及其切点。 程序编写器只使用标签来调整它从分级准则中产生的规则. 第5.3节对切点的分析支持这一解释。

blocks.en: Some cells of Table 1 come from separate single runs, marked † . In those runs, the programs with labels differ from our runs by up to 0.075. For comparisons that involve these cells, we therefore treat differences below 0.04 as ties. All other comparisons use the significance tests of Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 表1的一些单元格来自单独的单行,标记为 。 在这些运行中,带有标签的程序与我们的运行有0.075的差别. 对于涉及这些细胞的比较,我们因此将0.04以下的差异视为联系。 所有其他比较都采用了第4节的意义测试。

blocks.en: Figure 3. A few labels of the topic raise agreement. ExecJudges -L with 0–16 stratified labels and with the BM25 top 3 (open circles). Gray: the topic classifier.
blocks.zh: 图3. 本专题的几个标签引起一致意见。 ExecJudges - L,带有0–16分级标签,并带有BM25前3位(开放圆圈). Gray:主题分类器.

blocks.en: 5.2. Topic labels
blocks.zh: 5.2. 主题标签

blocks.en: A few human labels of a topic raise agreement substantially. Sixteen labels per topic raise the α \alpha of ExecJudges -L by 0.096 to 0.166 on the development and pilot collections. More than half of this gain comes from the first four labels, one per grade. The intervals of all these gains exclude 0. Figure 3 and Table 7 in Appendix A show these results. The labels also remove most of the bias toward high grades. A likely reason is that the guidelines alone leave open where the assessors drew the lines between the grades. The labels supply this information.
blocks.zh: 一个专题的几个人类标签大大地提高了共识。 每个话题的16个标签将执行法官的α-α-α-L在开发和试点收藏上提升0.096至0.166. 这一收益的一半以上来自前四个标签,每个等级一个. 所有这些收益的间隔期不包括 附录A图3和表7显示了这些结果。 标签也消除了大部分对高年级的偏见. 一个可能的原因是,准则本身没有规定陪审员在职等之间划线。 标签提供这一信息。

blocks.en: The choice of labeled passages matters more than their number. The three BM25 top passages change α \alpha by at most 0.031. The intervals of these changes include 0. A likely reason is that the BM25 top passages do not cover all grades. Appendix B discusses which passages to label.
blocks.zh: 选择标注的段落比其编号更重要. 三个BM25顶部段落最多以0.031改变α-α. 这些变化的间隔包括0. 一个可能的原因是,BM25顶级段落并不涵盖所有年级. 附录B讨论哪些段落可以标注。

blocks.en: ExecJudges -L stays above the LLM judges when the judges receive the same labels. The labels raise the α \alpha of the judges as well. ExecJudges -L remains above the listwise Sonnet judge by 0.117 on DL 2020 and by 0.037 on DL 2021. The intervals of both differences exclude 0. Appendix A lists the differences from the other judges. With labels, the Sonnet judges still grade too high on DL 2021. A likely reason is that the writer turns the labels into explicit rules. The programs apply these rules in the same way to every document of the pool.
blocks.zh: 执行法官 -- -- 在法官得到同样的称号时,在LLM法官之上。 标签也提高了法官的α-α. ExecJudges -L仍然高于列表Sonnet法官,在DL 2020上以0.117,在DL 2021上以0.037. 两种差异的间隔排除 附录 A列出了与其他法官的区别。 有了标签,Sonnet评委在DL 2021上评分仍然过高. 一个可能的原因是作者将标签转化为明确的规则. 程序以同样的方式将这些规则适用于池中的每一个文件.

blocks.en: 5.3. Comparison with supervised per-topic methods
blocks.zh: 5.3. 与受监督的每个专题方法的比较

blocks.en: ExecJudges -L agrees with NIST labels more than the topic classifier trained on the same labels. On the development and pilot collections, the gap in ordinal α \alpha is 0.050 to 0.106. The bootstrap intervals of all three gaps exclude 0. The paired t-test of Table 1 is not significant on DL 2019. The gap grows with fewer labels. It also holds for binary α \alpha . One-shot (16) is further below ExecJudges -L. Appendix A lists these values. The classifier grades too high. The analysis of the cut points below explains this bias.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges - L 同意 NIST 的标签, 而不是接受过相同标签培训的主题分类器. 在开发与试点收集上,正弦α-α的差距为0.050至0.106. 三个空白的间隔都排除了 0,表1的配对t测试在DL 2019上并不显著. 差距随着标签的减少而扩大。 它也持有二进制α-α. 1发(16发)进一步低于执行法官-附录。 A 列出这些值。 分类员的成绩太高了 下文对切点的分析说明了这种偏差。

blocks.en: The classifier needs many more labels to reach higher agreement than ExecJudges -L. With four times as many labels chosen by BM25, the classifier remains below ExecJudges -L with stratified labels. In the published setting of Gienapp et al., their classifiers use 64 to 256 labels per topic. These classifiers agree with NIST more than ExecJudges -L with 16 labels. Tables 13 and 11 in Appendix A list these results. The two methods therefore fit different label budgets. ExecJudges -L fits a few labels per topic. The classifier fits larger label sets.
blocks.zh: 分类器需要更多的标签才能达成比ExecJudges -L更高的协议. 分类器拥有BM25所选择的四倍的标签,所以分类器仍然位于ExecJudges -L以下,带有分级标签. 在Gienapp等人出版的设定中,他们的分类器每个话题使用64到256个标签. 这些分类人员同意NIST,胜过ExecJudges -L,有16个标签. 附录中的表13和表11 列出这些结果。 因此,这两种方法符合不同的标签预算。 ExecJudges - L 符合每个话题的几个标签. 分类器符合更大的标签集.

blocks.en: Figure 4. Share of Robust04 evaluation documents labeled relevant. Methods fitted to the stratified labels over-predict relevance.
blocks.zh: 图 4. Robust04评价文件的比重。 适用于分级标签的超预期相关性的方法。

blocks.en: ExecJudges -L also agrees with NIST labels more than the classifier and One-shot on the test collections. DL 2022, Robust04 and TREC-COVID were not used while designing the methods. ExecJudges -L is above the classifier on 69% to 89% of the topics of each collection. It is above One-shot (16) on a larger share of the topics. Figure 8 shows the per-topic results. The advantage of ExecJudges -L therefore does not depend on the collections that we used to design the method.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges -L也同意NIST标签多于测试集合上的分类器和一拍. DL 2022,Robust04和TREC-COVID在设计方法时没有使用. 执行法官 -L在分类器上,每集69%到89%的主题。 它高于一弹(16),涉及更多的专题。 图8显示每个专题的结果。 ExecJudges -L的优点因此不取决于我们用来设计方法的收藏.

blocks.en: The gap is largest when relevant documents are rare, because methods fitted to the labels then label too many documents relevant. Only 3.5% of the Robust04 evaluation documents are relevant. More than half of the stratified labels of a topic are relevant. Figure 4 shows this effect. Most of the gap comes from the cut points that turn scores into grades. Oracle cut points give the documents of each topic exactly their NIST grade distribution. With oracle cut points, both supervised baselines improve and remain significantly below ExecJudges -L at p < 0.05 p<0.05 . Class weights, MaxP scoring, the mean of per-topic α \alpha and the removal of duplicate DL 2022 passages do not change this order. Table 13 in Appendix A and Appendix B report these checks.
blocks.zh: 当相关文件很少时,缺口最大,因为贴在标签上的方法会给过多的相关文件贴上标签。 仅3.5%的Robust04评价文件具有相关性。 某一主题的分级标签有一半以上是相关的。 图4显示了这一影响。 差距大多来自将分数转化为分数的切点. Oracle切点给出每个主题的文档精确的NIST等级分布. 由于甲骨文切分点,两个受监督的基线都有改进,而且大大低于执行法官-L,p < 0.05 p < 0.05。 班次权重,MaxP评分,每题α\α的平均值和重复的DL 2022段的删除不会改变这个顺序. 附录A和附录B中的表13报告了这些检查。

blocks.en: 5.4. System rankings
blocks.zh: 5.4. 系统排名

blocks.en: Figure 5. System rankings in TREC style. Each point is one official run: its nDCG@10 under NIST labels and under a method’s labels. Points on the diagonal have the same score under both. Labeled passages keep their NIST grades. DL 2022: 65 topics.
blocks.zh: 图 5. TREC风格的系统排名. 每个点是一个正式运行:它的nDCG@10在NIST标签下和一种方法的标签下. 在对角线上的分数在两者下都有相同的分数. 标记的段落保持他们的NIST成绩. DL 2022: 65个话题.

blocks.en: ExecJudges and ExecJudges -L rank the official runs close to the ranking under NIST labels. We rank the official passage runs of DL 2019–2022 by nDCG@10 under each label set. Labeled passages keep their NIST grades. Unjudged passages have gain 0. Over all runs, Kendall’s τ \tau is 0.87 to 0.91 for ExecJudges and 0.93 to 0.94 for ExecJudges -L with 16 labels. Figure 5 shows DL 2021 and 2022. Table 8 in Appendix A lists all label sets. Ranking agreement at this level is usually considered acceptable for comparing systems.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges and Execjudges - L 排名该官员在NIST标签下排行接近排名. 我们把DL 2019–2022的正式通道运行按每套标签的nDCG@10进行排序. 标记的段落保持他们的NIST成绩. 未审经有增益. 肯德尔(Kendall)的“\tau”为0.87至0.91,而“L”为0.93至0.94。 图5显示的是DL 2021和2022. 附录表8 A 列出所有标签集 。 在比较系统时,通常认为这一级别的排序协议是可以接受的。

blocks.en: The topic classifier ranks the runs less accurately and inflates their scores. With the same labels, its τ \tau is 0.059 to 0.085 below ExecJudges -L on DL 2020–2022. The intervals of these differences exclude 0. The classifier labels also raise the nDCG@10 of every run. The ExecJudges -L labels change nDCG@10 by less than 0.01 on average. This inflation follows from the over-grading of the classifier reported in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 话题分类者对运行的排序不准确,并且夸大了他们的得分. 使用相同的标签,其\tau值为0.059至0.085,低于Execjudges - L on DL 2020-2022。 这些差异的间隔排除 0. 分类器的标签也提高了每个运行中的nDCG@10。 ExecJudges - L标签平均将nDCG@10修改不到0.01。 这种通货膨胀是由于第5.3节所报告的叙级员叙级过高所致。

blocks.en: Label agreement and ranking agreement can differ. The embedding cutoffs have low α \alpha on DL 2019 and 2020. Their τ \tau is still above 0.85. The BM25 cutoffs give negative τ \tau . These cutoffs give the highest gains to the passages that BM25-like runs retrieve. A label source therefore has to be evaluated with both measures.
blocks.zh: 标签协议和排名协议可能有所不同. 嵌入切片在DL 2019和2020上具有低α\α. 他们的\tau仍然高于0.85。 BM25断档给出负\ tau。 这些截断使BM25型运行回收的通道获得最高收益. 因此,必须对标签来源进行评估,同时采取这两项措施。

blocks.en: ExecJudges -L labels also make the pools the most reusable among the label sources we tested. We leave one run group at a time out of the DL 2019–2021 pools. The judged passages that only this group retrieved are then counted as non-relevant or labeled by a method. ExecJudges -L labels change the nDCG@10 of the left-out runs by less than 0.005 on average. This change is significantly smaller than for every other label source. Table 9 in Appendix A lists all label sources. Program labels can therefore fill the unjudged passages of a pool when new systems are evaluated.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges - L标签也使得集合是我们测试过的标签源中最可重复使用的. DL 2019–2021 游泳池一次离开一个跑步组. 被判断的只有这个组检索的段落,然后被算作无关或被某种方法贴上标签. ExecJudges - L标签将左侧运行的nDCG@10平均修改不到0.005. 这一变化大大小于其他标签来源。 附录中的表9 A 列出所有标签来源 。 因此,在评价新系统时,程序标签可以填补一个集合的未经判断的段落。

blocks.en: 5.5. Cost
Figure 6. API cost per topic with 16 labels. Writing the programs is a fixed cost. The programs are cheaper than the listwise judge beyond about 200 to 350 documents per topic (dots).
blocks.zh: 图 6. 每个主题的API成本,有16个标签. 编写程序是一种固定的成本。 程序比按列表判断的每个话题(dots)的大约200到350份文件要便宜.

blocks.en: The programs are cheaper than the listwise Sonnet judge once a topic has more than about 200 to 350 documents. Figure 6 shows this break-even point. Writing the programs costs $0.17 to $0.49 per topic. The programs then grade any number of documents without API calls. Grading takes less than one second per topic. The cost of the programs is paid once per topic and does not depend on the number of documents. The cost of an LLM judge grows with every document. The saving therefore grows with the depth of the pool.
blocks.zh: 一旦一个话题有超过200到350份文件,程序就比Sonnet法官便宜。 图6显示了这个断点。 编写程序的费用为每题0.17美元至0.49美元。 程序然后对没有 API 调用的任何文件数量进行分级 。 每个题目的分级需要不到一秒钟。 程序的费用每个题目支付一次,不取决于文件数量。 一名法学硕士法官的费用随每份文件而增加。 因此,储蓄随着水池的深度而增加。

blocks.en: The supervised baselines trade API cost for GPU time. The topic classifier has no API cost. Its training takes 13 seconds per topic on a GPU. The programs need no GPU, because they use only deterministic, lightweight operations. Table 5 in Appendix A lists the cost and time per collection.

blocks.en: 6. Analysis
blocks.zh: 6. 分析

blocks.en: We now analyze what the programs do, which design choices matter, and where the programs fail.
blocks.zh: 我们现在分析程序做什么,哪些设计选择很重要,哪些程序失败。

blocks.en: 6.1. The generated programs
blocks.zh: 6.1. 产生的程序

blocks.en: The programs are short and mostly lexical. The median program has about 70 lines and two functions. Topic-specific regular expressions and term lists make most decisions. On TREC DL, nearly all programs call jk.unrelated_share to decide whether a passage is dedicated to the query. On Robust04 and TREC-COVID, the programs encode the conditions of the narrative. For example, a whale-watching article counts only if it names Californian places at least half as often as other places. A hydroxychloroquine article gets grade 2 only if it describes a study. Figure 7 shows parts of these two programs. Table 6 in Appendix A gives the statistics per collection. The topic-specific criteria are therefore explicit in the code.
blocks.zh: 这些方案很短,而且大多是词汇。 中线程序约有70行,并有两个功能. 主题特定的正则表达式和术语列表做出大多数决定. 在TREC DL上,几乎所有程序都调用jk.unconnection_share来决定一个段落是否专用于查询. 在Robust04和TREC-COVID上,节目编码了叙事的条件. 例如,观鲸文章只有在加州地名的频率至少比其他地方的一半时才算数. 一条羟基氯quin(英语:Hydroxycholequin)的文章只有在描述一项研究时才能获得二级. 图7显示了这两个方案的部分内容。 附录中的表6 A提供每次收集的统计数据。 因此,具体专题的标准在守则中是明确的。

blocks.en: ExecJudges -L agrees with NIST more than the classifier on most topics. With the same labels, ExecJudges -L is ahead on 84 of the 142 development and pilot topics. A sign test gives p < 0.001 p<0.001 . Figure 8 shows the per-topic values. The largest gains are on topics about a named entity, such as who sings monk theme song , who is robert gray and what is mamey . On these topics, a relevant passage has to name the entity. The classifier is ahead on topics whose answer is a number or a comparison, such as reba mcentire’s net worth and difference between a hotel and motel . The rules of the programs do not capture these answers. The difference between the two methods is not related to pool size, the share of relevant passages or query length.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges - L在大多数议题上都比分类者更同意NIST. 以同样的标签,执行法官-L在142个发展和试点专题中领先84个。 标志测试给出p < 0.001 p < 0.001 。 图8显示每个专题的数值。 例如谁唱和尚主题曲, 谁是罗贝尔灰色, 关于这些议题,必须用相关段落来命名实体。 例如Reba mcentire的旅馆与汽车旅馆的净价值和差别。 程序的规则没有抓住这些答案. 两种方法的区别与池大小,相关段落的比例或查询长度无关.

blocks.en: 6.2. Design choices
blocks.zh: 6.2. 设计选择

blocks.en: The programs have to be written for each topic to reach the agreement of the LLM judges. The lexical classifier learns from Sonnet labels with the same kind of features as the programs. It is 0.20 to 0.47 below ExecJudges on the development and pilot collections. ExecJudges -Global and ExecJudges -GR share one program or one rubric across all topics. Both variants are below the lexical classifier on every year. Table 7 in Appendix A lists these results. The topic-specific rules and term lists therefore account for most of the agreement.
blocks.zh: 方案必须针对每个专题编写,以便获得LLM法官的同意。 词典分类者从Sonnet标签中学习,其特征与程序相同. 开发和试点收集方面的执行法官人数为0.20至0.47人。 执行法官 -- -- 全球法官和执行法官 -- -- GR共享一个方案或一个标题,涵盖所有专题。 两个变体都低于每年的词典分类法. 附录中的表7 列出这些结果。 因此,针对具体专题的规则和术语清单是协议的大部分内容。

blocks.en: Averaging more programs improves agreement up to three programs. We wrote two more programs per topic from the same prompt on the development and pilot collections. We then averaged every subset of k k programs. From k = 1 k=1 to k = 3 k=3 , α \alpha rises by 0.016 to 0.031. Most of the gain comes from the second program. Beyond three programs, the gain is smaller than the difference between two rewrites of the same program. Each program adds one writer call per topic. We therefore fixed k = 3 k=3 .
blocks.zh: 制定更多的方案可以改善多达三个方案的协议。 我们写了两个关于每个主题的节目 从同样的提示 关于开发和试点集。 然后,我们平均 每一个子集的kk程序。 从k=1 k=1到k=3 k=3,α\α上升0.016到0.031. 大部分收益来自第二个方案. 在三个程序之外,增益小于同一程序的两个重写之间的差额. 每个节目每个话题增加一个编剧呼叫. 因此,我们固定k=3k=3。

blocks.en: ExecJudges depends on a strong program writer. We replaced the program writer with an open-weight model and kept the same prompts, tests and repair step. Our implementation uses GPT-OSS-120B ( OpenAI, 2025 ) as the open-weight writer. With this writer, the α \alpha of ExecJudges is at most 0.486 on the development and pilot collections. All values of ExecJudges and ExecJudges -L are significantly below the values with the main writer at p < 0.01 p<0.01 . Table 7 lists these results. The programs of the open-weight writer grade too low. Writing rules that match the criteria of the assessors therefore requires a capable writer model at present.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges依赖于强大的程序编剧. 我们用一个开放量的模型取代了程序编剧,并保持同样的提示,测试和修复步骤. 我们的执行使用GPT-OSS-120B(OpenAI,2025年)作为开放量的写作机. 与这位作家合作,ExecJudges的α alpha最多为0.486的开发和试点收藏. Exec Judges和Exec Judges -L的所有值都大大低于主写者在p < 0.01 p < 0.01的值。 表7列出了这些结果。 开放量级的写作程序太低. 因此,与评审员标准相符的写作规则目前需要一个有能力的写作模式。

blocks.en: Corrections based on labeled errors did not raise agreement on new passages. We tried four ways to correct program errors after we fixed the main method. None of them raised agreement on passages outside those used for the correction. Appendix A describes these attempts. A likely reason is that corrections fitted to a few labeled errors do not generalize to other passages.
blocks.zh: 基于标注错误的更正并没有导致就新段落达成一致意见。 在修补了主要方法后,我们尝试了四种方法来纠正程序错误. 它们都没有就校正所用段落以外的段落达成协议。 附 录 A描述了这些尝试。 一个可能的原因是,一些贴上标签的错误的更正没有概括到其他段落。

blocks.en: 6.3. Errors

The largest error of ExecJudges is a missed top grade. On DL 2019 and 2020, ExecJudges gives grade 0 to more than a quarter of the passages that NIST graded 3. A few topics hold most of these errors. The labels remove most of this error. With labels, the share falls below 9%. ExecJudges -L also over-grades less than the classifier with the same labels. Table 12 in Appendix A lists all error types. A likely reason is that a labeled passage of the top grade shows the writer which evidence the assessors accepted for that grade.
blocks.zh: ExecJudges的最大错误是高年级失选. 在2019年和2020年的DL上,执行法官将0级授予NIST分级的四分之一以上段落. 3个 少数话题中包含了大多数这些错误. 标签删除了大部分错误 。 有了标签,股份下降到9%以下. ExecJudges - L 也比具有相同标签的分类器少的级别. 附录中的表12 A 列出所有错误类型 。 一个可能的原因是,标注在最高等级的段落中,可以显示哪些作者可以证明评委接受了该等级。

blocks.zh: 表3. DL 2022大错的段落. N:NIST;E:执行法官;L:执行法官-L(16);S:Sonnet,指针;C:分类员(16)。

blocks.en: The four methods make different kinds of errors. We compare them on the DL 2022 passages that the pointwise Sonnet judge also labeled. The classifier with 16 labels is two or more grades off the NIST grade on 17.0% of these passages. ExecJudges , ExecJudges -L and the Sonnet judge are two or more grades off on at most 7.7%. Most errors of the classifier are grades of 2 or 3 for passages that NIST graded 0. ExecJudges makes the opposite error. It gives grade 0 to passages that NIST graded 2 or 3. Table 3 shows one example of each kind of error. Appendix A gives the error counts of each method. These patterns match the biases reported above. The classifier grades too high. The programs without labels miss relevant passages.
blocks.zh: 这四种方法产生不同的错误。 我们在Sonnet评委 也标注的DL 2022段落上比较了它们。 16个标签的分类器是17.0%的这些段落比NIST等级低两个或两个以上. ExecJudges,ExecJudges -L和Sonnet法官的成绩最多为7.7%。 对于NIST分级的段落,分类器大多数错误是2或3级. 零点 执行法官作出相反的错误。 将NIST等级为2或3的段落给予0级. 表3显示每一种错误的一个实例。 附 录 A给出了每种方法的错误计数. 这些模式与上文所述的偏见相符。 分类员的成绩太高了 没有标签的程序错过了相关段落.

blocks.en: 6.4. Implications and limitations
blocks.zh: 6.4. 影响和限制

blocks.en: The results indicate where each variant fits. ExecJudges without labels fits passage collections with short queries. On the development and pilot collections, it agreed with NIST at the level of the Sonnet judges. ExecJudges -L fits when an assessor can label a few passages per topic. With 16 labels, it agreed with NIST more than both supervised baselines on every collection. Two settings call for caution: document collections with narrative topics, and the ordering of the best runs. The cost of both variants is fixed per topic. The saving over an LLM judge therefore grows with the depth of the pool.
blocks.zh: 结果表明每个变体适合何处。 没有标签的执行法官将段落集与简短的查询相匹配. 在开发和试点收集方面,它与Sonnet法官一级的NIST达成一致。 ExecJudges - L在评估者可以给每个话题贴上几段标签时符合. 有了16个标签,它与NIST在每一个收集上都比两个监督基线都多。 两个设置需要谨慎:带有叙事主题的文档集,以及最佳运行的顺序. 两种变体的成本按主题固定. 因此,LLM法官的节省随着池子的深度而增加。

blocks.en: Our study has four limitations. They concern the human labels, the ranking of the best systems, evaluation gaming, and the models that we used. For each limitation, we say what it means for the results.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究有四个局限性。 它们涉及到人类的标签,最佳系统的排名,评价游戏,以及我们使用的模型. 对于每个限制,我们说它意味着结果。

blocks.en: The better-performing variant, ExecJudges -L, requires human labels of each topic. In our experiments, the labels are stratified by grade. This selection requires the assessor grades before labeling. A practical procedure has to choose the passages without knowing their grades. The gains that we report for ExecJudges -L therefore show how much a given number of labels can help. A possible future direction is active learning, which requests labels from a human assessor or from a more capable and more expensive teacher model.
blocks.zh: 性能较好的变体ExecJudges -L,需要给每个主题贴上人类的标签. 在我们的实验中 标签按等级分级 此选择需要评估者在标签前的等级. 一个实用的程序必须在不知道成绩的情况下选择段落. 因此,我们向执行法官报告的收益表明,一定数量的标签可以帮助多少。 未来可能的方向是积极的学习,这要求从一个人类评估者或一个能力更强、费用更昂贵的教师模型中打上标签。

blocks.en: All methods that we compared order the best runs less reliably than the full set of runs. Over all runs, the ranking agreement of ExecJudges is at a level usually considered acceptable. On the ten runs that NIST ranks highest, τ \tau is lower and varies by year for every automatic method. Appendix A lists these values. The labels are therefore suited to comparing systems of different quality. More work is needed to make ExecJudges and other automatic evaluators reliable for ranking high-performing retrieval systems.
blocks.zh: 所有我们比较的方法 订单最好的运行 不如全套运行可靠。 在所有活动中,执行法官的排位协议通常被认为是可以接受的。 在NIST排名最高的十次运行中,\ tau更低,并且每个自动方法每年都有不同. 附 录 A 列出这些值。 因此,标签适合比较质量不同的系统。 还需要做更多的工作,使执行法官和其他自动评估人员能够可靠地对高性能检索系统进行排名。

blocks.en: Readable programs can be read by system builders as well as by evaluators. A system builder who reads a released ExecJudges program could tune a ranker to its rules. We did not test this risk. We also did not measure how well people can read and check the programs. While by examination, the programs appear well structured, we did not perform usability testing of the generated code, which may be a promising extension.
blocks.zh: 可读程序可由系统构建者以及评价者阅读. 一个系统构建者读取一个发布的ExecJudges程序,可以将一个分级符调整到它的规则. 我们没有测试这种风险。 我们还没有衡量人们阅读和检查节目的程度。 虽然通过检查,程序看起来结构良好,但我们并没有对生成的代码进行可用性测试,这可能是很有希望的扩展.

blocks.en: Our results were generated using one family of models and on a strong program writer. All LLM judges and all but one program writer were closed frontier models from Anthropic Claude family. With an open-weight writer, label agreement dropped (Section 6 ). The results may therefore differ for other model families. A natural extension is to test open models optimized for code generation. Such models could reduce the reliance on frontier models for this task.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果是用一个模型家族 和一个强大的程序作者创造的。 所有LLM评委和除了一位节目编剧之外,都是来自Anthropic Claude家族的封闭前沿模特. 与一位开放的作家,标签协议被取消(第6节)。 因此,其他模范家庭的结果可能有所不同。 一个自然延伸是测试为代码生成而优化的开放模型. 这种模式可以减少这项工作对前沿模式的依赖。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en:
This paper presented ExecJudges , a method that replaces the per-document calls of an LLM judge with executable programs that an LLM writes once for each topic. The programs then label document pools of any depth without further LLM calls, and people can inspect and rerun them. We demonstrated that ExecJudges agrees with NIST assessors at the level of a frontier LLM judge, Claude Sonnet 5.5, on TREC DL 2019–2021.
When a few human labels per topic are available, ExecJudges -L agrees with NIST more than per-topic classifiers ( Gienapp et al., 2026 ) given the same labels on all seven collections, and its agreement is either higher than that of LLM judges given the same labels or within about 0.05 of it in Krippendorff’s α \alpha . The resulting labels rank the official TREC DL runs close to the ranking under NIST labels, with Kendall’s τ \tau of 0.87 to 0.94. Writing the programs with one of the most capable frontier models incurs a one-time cost of less than $0.50 per topic, and does not depend on the number of result documents to label.
blocks.zh:
本文介绍了ExecJudges ,这种方法用一个LLM为每个话题写过一次的可执行程序来取代LLM法官的每份文件调用. 程序然后给任何深度的文档集合贴上标签而不再使用LLM调用,人们可以检查和重运行. 我们证明,执行法官们同意NIST一级LLM法官克劳德·索内特·5.5关于TREC DL 2019-2021的评委意见。
当每个主题都有几个人类标签时, ExecJudges-L与NIST(Gienapp等人, 2026年)更同意NIST, 由此产生的标签排名为TREC DL官方运行与NIST标签下的排名接近,肯德尔的\ tau为0.87到0.94. 用最有能力的前沿模型之一编写程序,每个主题的一次性费用不到0.50美元,不取决于要贴标签的结果文件的数量。

blocks.en: Possible future directions include testing and improving the robustness of ExecJudges to adversarial content such as keyword stuffing, and writing programs that judge several topics, or topics from different domains to reduce program generation costs, without loss of label agreement. Another direction is to extend the method to long-form generative IR, where ExecJudges could provide low-cost rewards for training generators, and to web-scale labeling workloads.
blocks.zh: 未来可能的方向包括测试和提高ExecJudges对关键词填充等对抗性内容的稳健性,以及写作程序来判断几个主题,或来自不同领域的主题,以减少程序生成成本,而不失去标签协议. 另一个方向是将该方法推广到长型基因IR(ExecJudges可以为培训发电机提供低成本奖励)和网络标注工作量。

blocks.en: This paragraph gives the values behind Sections 5.5 and 6 . Writing the programs costs $0.17 to $0.24 per topic without labels. With 16 labels, writing costs $0.20 to $0.49 per topic. The listwise Sonnet judge with 16 labels costs $0.53 to $2.31 per 1,000 judgments. Figure 6 uses $0.60 for TREC DL and $2.00 for Robust04 and TREC-COVID. The break-even points are about 350 and 200 documents per topic. In Figure 3 , 0 labels is ExecJudges , the values are on the residual passages, and the judge markers are shifted sideways. The median program has 66 to 75 lines and two functions. The median program contains 6 to 8 regular expressions and one to three toolkit calls. On Robust04, 92% of the programs look for one sentence that meets the conditions of the topic. With 16 labels, the programs list fewer terms and use one more regular expression. With 16 labels each, ExecJudges -L is ahead of the classifier by more than 0.02 on 84 of 142 DL 2019–2021 topics. It is behind on 42 topics. ExecJudges -L gains 0.6 to 1.0 on the named-entity topics. All Spearman correlations of the per-topic difference with pool size, the share of relevant passages and query length satisfy | ρ | ≤ 0.15 |\rho|\leq 0.15 with p > 0.07 p>0.07 . In the larger set of programs that contains the prompt variants of Appendix C , going from three to five programs adds only 0.005 to 0.009. Going from five to seven programs adds 0.002 to 0.007. Two rewrites of the same program differ by up to 0.024 on one collection. Each writer call costs about one third of the writing cost. With GPT-OSS-120B as the writer, ExecJudges reaches 0.486, 0.393 and 0.344 on DL 2019–2021. ExecJudges -L with 16 labels reaches 0.521, 0.467 and 0.438. The mean difference of the GPT-OSS programs from the NIST grade is − - 0.14 to − - 0.48. On DL 2019 and 2020, ExecJudges gives grade 0 to 26% and 28% of the passages that NIST graded 3. The Sonnet judge gives grade 0 to 24% and 17% of these passages. Four topics per year hold 90 to 95% of these errors. With labels, the share falls to 1.2%, 8.1% and 1.3% on DL 2019–2021. On DL 2019–2021, ExecJudges -L gives grade 2 or 3 to 2.5 to 4.5% of the passages that NIST graded 0. The classifier gives these grades to 7.0 to 11.6% of these passages. On the 7,402 DL 2022 passages that the pointwise Sonnet judge also labeled, ExecJudges , ExecJudges -L and the Sonnet judge are two or more grades off on 7.7%, 5.6% and 5.3%. The classifier gives grades of 2 or 3 to 25.2% of the NIST grade-0 passages. The other three methods give them to at most 6.3%. ExecJudges gives grade 0 to 10.6% of the passages that NIST graded 2 or 3. The other three methods give grade 0 to at most 5.8% of these passages.

blocks.en: In this setting, the classifiers of Gienapp et al. agree with NIST more than every other method. We use their DL 2020 evaluation passages and their released predictions. Table 11 lists the results. Their classifiers trained on 64 to 256 labels per topic reach α \alpha of 0.81 to 0.88. ExecJudges -L with 16 stratified labels reaches 0.674. ExecJudges reaches 0.485. GPT-4o with the UMBRELA prompt reaches 0.526. The Sonnet judge reaches 0.557. The share of relevant passages in this evaluation set ranges from 0% to 100% across topics. Pooled α \alpha is therefore higher for a method that labels the correct share in each topic. On the 28 topics with more than 50 relevant passages, the 64-label classifier reaches only 0.681. The training labels of these classifiers are 94% non-relevant. With 64 of these labels, the programs label too few passages relevant. Appendix B describes this experiment.

GPT-4o,UMBRELA的速率达到0.526。 松网裁判达到0.557. 本评价集相关段落的比例从0%到100%不等。 因此,集合的α\α对于给每个主题的正确份额贴上标签的方法来说更高. 在有50多个相关段落的28个话题上,64标签分类器只达到0.681. 这些分类人员的培训标签为94%无关。 有了64个这些标签,程序标签上的相关段落太少. 附 录 B描述了这个实验.

blocks.en: We tried four ways to correct program errors after we fixed the main method. None of them raised agreement on passages outside those used for the correction. First, the writer revised the shared code that turns the answers into a grade. We split DL 2019 and 2020 into 57 training topics and 37 held-out topics for this test. In four rounds, held-out α \alpha changed by − - 0.014 to +0.003. Second, the writer revised a block of guidance in its own prompt. The one round within the 350-word limit lowered held-out α \alpha by 0.010. Third, the writer revised each ExecJudges -L program after seeing its errors on the 16 labeled passages. The errors on these passages fell from 9–12% to 3–4%. On the other passages, α \alpha changed by only +0.002, − - 0.005 and +0.006. Fourth, the writer induced written guidelines per year from 10 topics with NIST labels. These guidelines lowered α \alpha on the other topics by 0.017 on DL 2019 and by 0.037 on DL 2021. The interval of the DL 2021 change excludes 0. We also fitted a rule per year that maps the four answers to grades. This rule lost 0.02 to 0.05 α \alpha on topics it was not fitted on. The released package will contain the guidelines and revision logs.
blocks.zh: 在修补了主要方法后,我们尝试了四种方法来纠正程序错误. 它们都没有就校正所用段落以外的段落达成协议。 首先,编剧修改了将答案变为等级的共享代码. 将DL 2019和2020分为57个培训课题和37个预留课题进行本次测试. 四轮中,被搁置的α-α改为−−0.014改为+0.03. 第二,编者迅速修订了一组指导。 350字限制内的一回合将搁置的α-α降低0.010。 第三,编剧在看到16个标注段落的错误后,修改了每个ExecJudges -L程序. 这些段落的错误从9–12%下降到3–4%. 在其他段落上,α\α只更改了+0.002,−−0.005和+0.006. 第四,作者每年从带有NIST标签的10个专题中引领书面指南. 这些准则将关于其他专题的α-α降低到DL 2019的0.017和DL 2021的0.037。 2021年DL变化的间隔不包括0. 我们还每年设置一个规则,将四个答案映射到等级. 这一规则在它没有适应的专题上损失了0.02至0.05 α α α。 发布的包将包含准则和修订日志。

blocks.en: Most large errors are made by only one of the four methods. We count passages that are two or more grades off the NIST grade on the 7,402 passages of Table 3 . Only the classifier is off on 884 passages. Only ExecJudges is off on 226 passages. Only the Sonnet judge is off on 130 passages. Only ExecJudges -L is off on 91 passages. All four methods are off on 47 passages. The over-grading of the classifier occurs on 63 of the 65 topics. The missed grades of ExecJudges occur on 36 topics. One topic, example of what a family advocate does , holds 31 of these 149 passages. With 16 labels, 37 of these passages receive grade 2 or 3. Each program error in Table 3 traces back to a term list or pattern in the code.
blocks.zh: 多数大错只用四种方法中的一种. 我们在表3的7,402段里,计算出离NIST分数两个或两个以上的段落。 只有分类器关闭在884段。 只有执行法官在226个通道上休息。 只有索内法官在130个段落上下车. 只有执行法官 - 我停在91个通道上 所有四种方法在47个段落上关闭. 65个专题中,63个专题的分类器的分级过高。 执行法官的职等错失涉及36个专题。 其中31段是家庭代言人的例子。 有16个标签,其中37个段落获得2级或3级. 表3中的每个程序错误都追溯到代码中的术语列表或模式.

blocks.en: Appendix B Method details and further analyses
blocks.zh: 方法细节和进一步分析

blocks.en: DL 2021 served as the pilot test. After the pilot, we changed the program to return answers to the grade questions, replaced the single rubric program with the mean of three per-query programs, and added ExecJudges -L and all label-based baselines.
blocks.zh: DL 2021担任试飞员. 试播集之后,我们更改了程序以返回分级问题的答案,将单笔程序替换为每行3个每行程序的平均值,并增加了ExecJudges -L和所有基于标签的基线.

blocks.en: We tuned three settings of the topic classifier because the released settings fail on our labels. The classifier trains one LoRA adapter per topic on monoT5-base with rank 64 and α = 128 \alpha=128 . We keep the released optimizer settings and the mean squared error loss. With the released input pairs, 10 epochs and example weights of 0.95 and 0.05, the classifiers labeled almost every DL 2019 passage relevant. We tuned three settings on 8 DL 2019 topics. These settings are the input format of monoT5, 60 epochs and the inverse share of relevant labels as example weights. We report a graded version that trains on the grade divided by 3. It cuts the score at ( g − 0.5 ) / 3 (g-0.5)/3 for g = 1 , 2 , 3 g=1,2,3 . On the tuning topics, the graded version reached binary α \alpha of 0.62 against 0.57 for the binary version. The graded version reads the first 512 tokens of each document. Table 13 reports both variants. On the 32 DL 2019 topics outside the tuning topics, ExecJudges -L is 0.047 above the classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们调制了3个主题分类器的设置, 因为释放的设置在我们的标签上失败了 。 分类器在单T5基座上每题列车1列LORA适配器,等级为64级,α=128\α=128. 我们保留释放的优化器设置和平均平方误差损失. 随着释放的输入对,10个纪元和0.95和0.05的示例权重,分类者几乎每个DL 2019通道都贴上标签. 我们调制了8个DL2019主题的3个设置. 这些设置是单T5,60个纪元的输入格式,以及相关标签作为示例权重的反向份额. 我们报告一个分级的版本 在分级的火车除以3。 它在(g−0.5)/3(g−0.5)/3对g=1,2,3g=1,2,3的比分中切分. 在调音题上,分级版达到二进制α\alpha0.62对0.57对二进制版. 分级版本读取每个文档的前512个符号. 表13报告两种变式。 在调制主题以外的32个DL 2019主题上,ExecJudges -L在分类器上方为0.047.

blocks.en: The best rounding direction depends on the bias of single programs. On DL 2019–2021, single programs grade too high. On DL 2021, they are 0.27 too high on average. Rounding the mean down then gives higher α \alpha than rounding to the nearest grade. The gain is 0.003, 0.006 and 0.017. On the held-out collections, single programs are close to unbiased on DL 2022 and Robust04. They grade too low on TREC-COVID by 0.15 to 0.19. Rounding to the nearest grade then gives 0.557, 0.413 and 0.576. ExecJudges with rounding down reaches 0.549, 0.392 and 0.508. The difference is significant at p < 0.01 p<0.01 on Robust04 and TREC-COVID. The rounding direction should follow the bias of the programs. Labeled passages can measure this bias when they exist.
blocks.zh: 最佳的四舍五入方向取决于单一程序的偏差. 在DL 2019–2021上,单项节目分级过高. 在DL 2021上,它们平均为0.27太高. 将平均值四舍五入后,将α-α比四舍五入更接近的级别。 增益为0.003,0.006和0.017. 在被搁置的集合上,单项程序在DL 2022和Robust04上接近无偏见. 它们在TREC-COVID上的分数过低,为0.15至0.19。 四舍五入到最接近的等级,然后给予0.557,0.413和0.576. 四舍五入的法官人数达到0.549、0.392和0.508。 在Robust04和TREC-COVID的p < 0.01 p < 0.01上,差别很大。 四舍五入的方向应当遵循程序的偏差. 标签段落可以测量这种存在时的偏差.

blocks.en: Disagreement among the programs of a topic does not identify the topics on which the programs fail. On the held-out collections, the programs of a topic disagree on 23.6%, 6.7% and 21.7% of its evaluation documents on average. This share is not correlated with the α \alpha of the topic. The Spearman correlations are − - 0.05, +0.14 and +0.11 with p > 0.2 p>0.2 .
blocks.zh: 主题程序之间的分歧不能确定程序失败的主题。 关于被搁置的收集,一个专题的方案平均有23.6%、6.7%和21.7%的评价文件有分歧。 这一份额与本专题的α-α无关。 斯皮尔曼的关联性为− - 0.05,+0.14和+0.11,p > 0.2 p>0.2.

blocks.en: The classifier needs 16 stratified labels to reach the level of ExecJudges on DL 2022 and TREC-COVID. With 16 labels, it reaches 0.573 and 0.506 against 0.549 and 0.507 for ExecJudges . One-shot (16) is level with ExecJudges on DL 2022 and below it on the other two collections. Its scores still rank the documents of a topic well. The mean per-topic AUC for NIST grade ≥ \geq 1 is 0.74 to 0.78. MaxP scoring takes the maximum score over windows of 150 words. It labels 43% of the Robust04 documents relevant. The mean of per-topic α \alpha orders the methods as pooled α \alpha does. On DL 2022 with one passage per distinct text, ExecJudges -L reaches 0.669 and the classifier 0.518.
blocks.zh: 分类器需要16个分级标签才能在DL 2022和TREC-COVID上达到执行法官级别. 有16个标签,对执行法官来说达到0.573和0.506,对0.549和0.507。 一弹一弹(16)在DL 2022上与ExecJudges同为一级,在下方是另外两集. 它的分数仍然对一个话题的文件排好 NIST级别 \\ geq 1 的平均值为 0.74 到 0.78。 最大P积分在150字的窗口上取最大分数. 它标注了43%的Robust04相关文档. 每个主题的α α α 的平均值 命令的方法 集合 α α α 的 。 在《第2022号法规》中,执行法官-L达到0.669,分类员为0.518。

blocks.en: Rubric programs agree with NIST no better than per-query programs. Induced rubrics improve LLM judges in prior work ( Farzi and Dietz, 2025 ) . In our setting, the writer compiles an induced rubric into lexical checks of a program. ExecJudges -R agrees with NIST as well as ExecJudges -1P on the development years. The differences are − - 0.008 and +0.028 and not significant. On DL 2021, ExecJudges -R is 0.044 below ExecJudges -1P. Each criterion becomes a lexical check that can fail. A failed check at the lowest level sets the grade to 0. On DL 2019 and 2020, ExecJudges -R gave grade 0 to 23–28% of the passages NIST graded 3 in this way. The per-query program already decomposes relevance into the grade questions of the guidelines. An induced rubric repeats these questions and adds checks that can fail. This result concerns rubrics compiled into programs. We did not test rubrics applied by an LLM judge.
blocks.zh: Rubric方案与NIST一致,并不比每个溪流方案更好. 引人注意的是,在以前的工作中改进了LLM法官(Farzi和Dietz,2025年)。 在我们的环境下,作者将一个诱导标题编译成一个程序的词典检查. 执行法官-R同意NIST以及执行法官-1P关于开发年的意见。 差异为−-0.008和+0.028,并不显著。 在 DL 2021 中, ExecJudges - R 低于 ExecJudges - 1P 。 每个标准都成为可能失败的词典检查 。 最低级的检查失败, 等级为 0 。 在2019年和2020年的DL上,ExecJudges -R以这种方式给出了NIST3级的0至23–28%的分数. 单管程序已经将相关性分解为准则的等级问题. 诱导标题重复这些问题,并添加可能失败的检查. 这一结果涉及编成程序的标题。 我们没有测试LLM法官应用的题材。

blocks.en: A program should return the answers to the grade questions or a grade. A binary output lowers agreement. We compared the three outputs with the 64 labels of the DL 2020 setting of Table 11 . A program that returns a binary label is below the four answers of ExecJudges in binary α \alpha by 0.113 for a single program. The interval of this difference is 0.059 to 0.170. For the mean of three programs, the difference is 0.191. Its interval is 0.124 to 0.265. A program that returns a grade 0–3 does not differ from the four answers. The difference is − - 0.009 with an interval of − - 0.054 to +0.039.
blocks.zh: 程序应该返回对分级问题的答案或分级. 二进制输出降低协议. 我们把这三项产出与表11DL 2020设定的64个标签进行了比较。 一个返回二进制标签的程序低于ExecJudges在二进制α\alpha中以0.113为单程序的四个答案. 此差值的间隔为0.059至0.170. 对于三个方案的平均值,差额为0.191. 其间距为0.124至0.265. 返回等级 0–3 的程序与四个答案没有区别. 差值为−-0.009,间隔为−-0.054至+0.039.

blocks.en: The labels should cover all grades. In the DL 2020 setting, the 64 labels had to come from judged passages outside the evaluation set of the released classifiers. Only 4.7 of these 64 labels per topic were relevant on average. With these labels, the programs label 23–26% of the passages relevant. NIST labels 50% of them relevant. The programs reach binary α \alpha of 0.33 to 0.38. These values are below ExecJudges without labels at 0.50. We told the writer that relevant passages are under-represented among the labels. This note raised α \alpha to 0.41 to 0.46. The intervals of these gains include 0. The BM25 top-3 result of Section 5.2 points the same way.
blocks.zh: 标签应覆盖所有年级。 在DL 2020设定中,64个标签必须来自被发布的分类器评价集之外的判断段落. 每个专题的64个标签中平均只有4.7个相关。 有了这些标签,程序标注了23-26%的段落。 NIST的标签50%相关. 程序达到0.33至0.38的二进制 α\α. 这些数值低于0.50的无标签执行法官。 我们告诉作家,相关段落在标签中的代表性不足。 这份说明将α-α提高到0.41至0.46。 这些收益的间隔期包括: 0. 第5.2节的BM25前3级结果指向同样的方式。

blocks.en: None of three prompt variants improved a single per-query program. We tested the variants after the pilot. The first variant uses stemmed phrase matching in any order with static checks. The second variant adds embedding similarity from bge-small-en-v1.5. The third variant uses one shared grading function with per-topic settings. On DL 2021, the variants reached α \alpha of 0.615, 0.606 and 0.581 on all judged passages of the pilot run. The program of Section 3 reached 0.636. We use the variant programs only in the pooled analysis of the number of programs.
blocks.zh: 三个即时变体中没有一个改进了单个每克程序. 试飞后测试了变体. 第一个变体使用任何顺序的静态检查中对应的句子。 第二个变体增加了bge-small-en-v1.5的嵌入相似性. 第三个变式使用一个按专题设置的共享分级功能. 在DL 2021上,该变体在试运行的所有判断段落上达到α\α0.615,0.606和0.581. 第3节的方案达到0.636。 我们只在对方案数量进行集合分析时使用变体程序。
